title: Use current Supabase project in Pages deploy
body: ## Summary - Keep the browser Supabase client configured via `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`. - Set the production GitHub Pages build to use active Supabase project `bdkaqgvzjkixwakzploq` instead of stale repo secret value. - Fix the live checkout error where `earthsongfestival.com` still called the old `gontbearierzkbyvyubw` edge function project. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] After this deploys, reopen the ticket checkout modal on `earthsongfestival.com`, fill name/email, check agreement, and click Proceed to Payment. - [ ] Confirm Stripe Checkout opens. - [ ] If the live bundle still references `gontbearierzkbyvyubw`, clear browser/cache/CDN and confirm GitHub Pages finished deploying this PR. ### Notes - Root cause: the live site bundle contained `https://gontbearierzkbyvyubw.supabase.co`, while the active edge functions are deployed at `https://bdkaqgvzjkixwakzploq.supabase.co`. - I attempted to update GitHub Actions secrets directly, but the GitHub app token cannot manage repo Actions secrets (`403 Resource not accessible by integration`). - Verified the correct `create-checkout` edge function returns Stripe Checkout URLs for `https://earthsongfestival.com` and `https://www.earthsongfestival.com` origins. - Verified `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, and `npm test`; lint has only existing Fast Refresh warnings. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e9b927241a78495e8d9d5325297fcbb1 Requested by: @tbdcmarketing ---
